prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the noolim, a darting shoal of dull silver slivers from the dark floor of the Twilight, seen as a shoal and never as one individual. The shoal is an irregular, swirling, open cloud of about twenty separate slivers, with three or four strays drifting just outside the main spread. Every sliver is the same shape: a long, thin, sharply pointed shard of dull silver with a flat narrow cross-section, a crisp painted edge, a thin dark contour line of its own and a dull metallic glint along one edge. Shading is restrained and painterly, in flat-to-two-tone strokes. The slivers have no fin, no tail and no head. They sit at many different angles and depths, streaming and turning together as if darting through water, with clear gaps of transparent background between neighbours. Side views (east and west): the thin shards lie side-on as long slender silver slivers at varied angles in a loose layer with open space showing through the centre, all swept the same way along the direction of travel. Colouring is dull, unlit silver with a deeper shade of the local colour along the edges. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style with clean dark outlines. Exactly ONE shoal, centred, the whole cloud visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.

prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the tammuq, a squat burrower that spends almost its whole life motionless under cracked clay, sealed in a wax-lined burrow. Its body is an irregular, slumped, lumpy clod of fused cracked-clay armour, low, wider than long, hunched and asymmetric. The armour grows out of the trunk itself as uneven overlapping crust slabs separated by seams of pale wax, like a dried clay pan, and the outline is a rough, lumpy mass. Four short, heavy shovel-limbs with broad flat digging blades are tucked under the trunk, with only the blade tips showing at the edge of the mass. They are fused clay-armoured limbs, thick and blunt. The head is a broad, sealed digging snout, a wedge-shaped plough of fused armour that merges into the front of the trunk with no neck; two tiny dull eye-slits sit in the upper edge of the plough, and the snout is the lowest, narrowest part of the silhouette. The rear is a heavy blunt haunch of stacked slabs. Pale cream wax is a glossy crust that seeps from the seams between the slabs and pools in the hollows and at the limb joints, like candle drippings. The body has one consistent breadth, mass, height and stance width throughout. The palette is clay browns and ochres with pale cream wax. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, with soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour and a clean dark outline. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
